data.name: Adnan
data.gender_notes: Adnan is used as a male name in islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: From the Arabic root ع-د-ن (ʿ-d-n), 'to settle, dwell'. Adnān means 'settler'. Its root is ع-د-ن (ʿ-d-n). Adnan, the traditional ancestor of the northern Arabs. Adnan is a Arabic name meaning “Settler; one who settles”. Families who choose it generally do so for the quality the name expresses.
data.spiritual_meaning: Adnan expresses “Settler; one who settles”; spiritual readings of the name are interpretive.
data.etymology: From the Arabic root ع-د-ن (ʿ-d-n), 'to settle, dwell'. Adnān means 'settler'.
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Adnan total 16, reducing to 7. Number 7 is associated with reflection, analysis and inner search.
